build_lora_batch_info: build a LoRABatchInfo dataclass with CUDA graph settings, batch size, segments, and adapter metadata
get_hidden_dim_modules: get hidden dimensions for LoRA target modules like qkv_proj, o_proj, gate_up_proj, and down_proj from a model config
normalize_lora_target_modules: normalize LoRA target module names by mapping PEFT shorthands and base names to canonical LoRA module identifiers
auto_detect_lora_targets: auto-detect LoRA-compatible target modules by inspecting a PyTorch model's layer types and graph
compute_lm_head_pruned_lens: compute per-sequence pruned lengths for lm_head LoRA based on forward mode and logprob settings
